brief_context: Quoted regarding the role of the Electricity Supply Industry.
brief_extract: Productivity is basically the concern of industry, but industrial prosperity vitally affects us all not only by its financial benefits and in raising our national standard of living, but also by the later application to the domestic sphere of the new techniques which have resulted from industrial research and development. In sending good wishes to a recent conference on Electricity for Productivity, arranged by E.D.A., the President of the Board of Trade said that "the Electricity Supply Industry provides a large share of the rising energy demands of our productive industries". Last year industry accounted for about half the amount of electricity sold, domestic users for one-third, and one-eighth was taken by shops and offices, etc.

brief_extract:
PETRIE describes

A Demonstrator’s Work
in the North of Scotland

The Background
It was wartime, teachers were scarce, classes
were large. I wanted to have German as a subject
but the Headmaster said “Sorry—try Domestic
Science instead”. I did, found it an interesting
subject, and from the time of that one decision
followed a path for the next 15 years that was to
take me into countless houses in the North of
Scotland, meeting people with varied back-
grounds, sharing with them their experiences of
post-war progress.

brief_context: A 53-year-old experienced linesman mentioned by Jack Walton.
article_title: Advertisement: Central Electricity Generating Board - I wouldn't swap it!
brief_extract: "You're as young as you feel" he points out. "Big Jimmy is fifty three, and he still climbs with the best."
